review.imagery: 34 gallery entries include 7 dated site photographs. All 26 primary assets, the entire current 36-page and earlier 35-page brochure indexes, nine native resources and seven September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Three exact primary repeats and repeated brochure lobby/clubhouse crops were excluded. Four brochure scenes add duplex living, dining, bedroom and clubhouse detail. Shared interiors also appear in other Imtiaz marketing and retain concept scope. The full daylight building supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All nine whole original physical pages 2–10 were visually reviewed on three contacts. Three publicly displayed 1 BR drawings were independently viewed at native size. They show no numerical areas. Their filenames are not treated as contractual unit confirmation. Twelve remaining broker layouts are form-gated and unretrieved. The separate duplex portions were not assigned independent whole-home areas. Nine full building sheets and three attributed broker 1 BR previews are available. Grouped levels and duplex portions retain their original labels. No numerical individual saleable area is printed. Confirm contractual home matching, complete duplex areas and final drawings with Imtiaz.
review.location: Complete original brochure map 18 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. All chosen times follow its printed list. The nearest metro remains unnamed and historical landmark wording is qualified. The current official named-place embed has no explicit target coordinates. Camera-centre values were excluded.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction pages have dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures and drawings retain Tanami, Mitchell’s, REMapp or Reelly attribution according to the actual host. Public home images, where available, retain their openly observed figure URLs. Source bytes, whole sheets and protected researched records remain intact.
